## Open Science {#open-science}

Open science connects research questions, methods, and evidence through accessible publications and code.

My public work includes code for precipitation nowcasting and publications on hydrology and water quality. <br><br>

### What I share

- [GitHub](https://github.com/kiwiyolo?tab=repositories): my profile and public repositories.
- [Suitable-coupling-for-PN](https://github.com/kiwiyolo/Suitable-coupling-for-PN): code accompanying *Coupling strategies for precipitation nowcasting in China*. <br>
  → [Read the paper](https://doi.org/10.1080/02626667.2025.2587687).
- [Publications](publications.qmd): journal articles and a conference abstract, with DOI links.

### Reproducibility and collaboration

Follow each repository's documentation and licence when using the code. Data sources and access conditions are described in the associated publications.

- [Research resources](datasets.qmd): find the relevant data availability statements.
- [Talks and conferences](talks.qmd#talks-workshops): conference contributions.
- [Contact me](contact.qmd) with questions about methods or possible collaborations.
